method.water_index: NDWI = (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08), adaptive Otsu threshold
method.cloud_mask: Sentinel-2 Scene Classification Layer; classes 0,1,3,8,9,10,11 excluded
method.tide: Nearest NOAA CO-OPS Cape May water level, MSL datum
method.high_tide_screen: Capture must fall within +/- 90 minutes of a NOAA-predicted Cape May high tide
method.waves: Nearest NOAA NDBC 44009 significant wave height and dominant period
method.wave_setup: Stockdon setup term: 0.35 * beach slope * sqrt(H0 * L0)
method.horizontal_normalization: Observed line shifted along local seaward normal by (tide + setup) / beach slope
